links.comparator_used: Same ChatGPT questions asked without the short prompt asking for an accurate, easy-to-understand answer for the average person
links.outcome: Response relevance and consistency improved, accuracy did not change significantly (radiologist-rated)
links.quote: Fewer unprompted responses were considered fully relevant at 67% (176 of 264), although this increased significantly to 80% when prompts were given (210 of 264; P = .001).

links.comparator_used: Same ChatGPT questions asked without the short prompt requesting an easy-to-understand response for the average person
links.outcome: Readability measured by Flesch Kincaid Grade Level
links.effect: Unprompted 13.6 (CI 12.9-14.2) vs prompted 13.0 (CI 12.41-13.60), P = .2. No responses reached the eighth-grade level.
links.quote: The average Flesch Kincaid Grade Level was high at 13.6 [CI, 12.9-14.2], unchanged with the prompt (13.0 [CI, 12.41-13.60], P = .2).
